scenario: An endocrine authorization bridge should reopen only after the authorization ticket, insurer message, prior authorization note, requirement note, and final referral note still point to the fresh referral lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the endocrine authorization bridge for case MED-1610. Start from authorization ticket AUT-1610, rebuild the supporting trail it references, and only take the approved close step if the bridge still lines up.

medical_authorization_case_tickets.body_text: Authorization ticket AUT-1610: rebuild the endocrine authorization bridge by checking insurer message IM-1610, prior authorization note PAN-1610, requirement note RQN-1610, and the final referral note for MED-1610. If no active endocrinology referral remains and the late trail still aligns, the approved close step is to submit a fresh endocrinology referral.

medical_insurer_messages.body_text: Insurer message IM-1610: the previous endocrinology authorization window closed after intake drift. Once the authorization bridge is rebuilt and no active endocrinology referral remains, reopen the lane by submitting a fresh endocrinology referral.

medical_prior_authorization_notes.body_text: Prior authorization note PAN-1610: the earlier endocrinology authorization expired when the intake packet aged out. Do not attempt booking from this lane.

medical_referral_requirement_notes.body_text: Requirement note RQN-1610: if MED-1610 has no active endocrinology referral left, the approved close step for the authorization bridge is to submit a new endocrinology referral.

medical_case_notes.body_text: Case note CN-1610: the late authorization bridge still closes through the fresh endocrinology referral lane once every supporting carrier lines up.

medical_referral_notes.body_text: Referral note for MED-1610: the final bridge check still points to the approved close step of submitting a fresh endocrinology referral.
